name: Random Number Generator
short: Generate random numbers in any range for draws, games and picks.

seo.metaTitle: Random Number Generator - Pick Numbers in Any Range Free
seo.metaDescription: Free random number generator. Generate one or many random numbers in any range, with or without duplicates. Ideal for draws, games, sampling and picks.

intro: This free random number generator produces one or many random numbers in any range you choose, instantly and fairly. Set a minimum and maximum, say how many numbers you need, decide whether duplicates are allowed, and click Generate. Behind the scenes it uses the cryptographically secure random source built into your browser, the same quality of randomness used in encryption. That makes it far more trustworthy than a spreadsheet formula or someone shouting a number from the back of the room. Whether you are running a giveaway, drawing raffle winners, assigning teams or sampling survey responses, this number picker gives every value in the range an equal chance, and it does it all on your device.
howto: Enter the minimum and maximum values of your range, for example 1 to 100, or 1 to the number of raffle tickets sold.
Choose how many numbers you want to generate at once.
Decide whether duplicates are allowed. Untick 'Allow duplicates' for prize draws so no ticket can win twice.
Click Generate and your numbers appear instantly.
Click Copy to grab the results for a spreadsheet, an announcement post or your records.
For a public draw, consider screen recording the moment you generate, so participants can see the result was produced live.
benefits: Fairness is the whole point of a random draw, and fairness depends on the quality of the randomness. This generator uses the browser's cryptographic random source rather than a basic formula, so results are statistically unbiased and every number in your range has an exactly equal chance. The no-duplicates mode also does the bookkeeping a manual draw gets wrong: once a number is drawn, it cannot come up again.

It is quick for real work too. Generate a hundred sample IDs in one click and paste them straight into a spreadsheet. Everything runs locally, so nothing about your draw is sent anywhere. If your giveaway needs supporting tools, they are one click away. Announce winners with a scannable link from the [QR code generator](/tools/qr-code-generator/), count down to the draw date with the [date difference calculator](/tools/date-difference-calculator/), or set up a prize account with the [password generator](/tools/password-generator/).
useCases: Social media managers and small businesses use it for giveaway draws: number the entrants, generate one winner, screenshot the result. Raffle organizers at schools, clubs and charities draw ticket numbers without pulling paper from a hat. Teachers pick a random student for a question, set presentation order, or split a class into random groups. With duplicates off, everyone gets picked exactly once.

Researchers use random numbers for sampling, like choosing which 50 of 800 survey responses to audit, and for splitting participants into test groups. Game nights use it as a giant dice roller when the real dice have gone missing. Sports coaches draw fixtures and knockout brackets with it. Developers generate quick test IDs during development. Any decision that should be visibly fair is a job for this tool.

faqs.a: They come from your browser's cryptographically secure random generator, which is far stronger than basic random functions. For draws, games, sampling and picks, the results are statistically unbiased and fair.
Yes. Untick 'Allow duplicates' and every generated number will be unique, which is exactly what you want for raffles where a ticket must not win twice.

faqs.q: Is there a limit to the range?
faqs.a: You can use any practical range, from 1 to 2 up to millions. Both the minimum and maximum are included in the possible results.

faqs.q: Can anyone predict or influence the results?
faqs.a: No. Cryptographic randomness is unpredictable by design, and because generation happens on your device, there is no server for anyone to tamper with.

faqs.q: Is this suitable for a public giveaway draw?
faqs.a: Yes. Assign each entrant a number, generate the winner, and screenshot or record the draw for transparency. Many small businesses run their contest draws exactly this way.

faqs.q: Can I use it as a dice roller or coin flip?
faqs.a: Absolutely. Set the range to 1 to 6 for a die, generate two numbers for a pair of dice, or use 1 to 2 for a coin flip with heads on 1 and tails on 2.
